text: A hollow drum-spirit with two rune arms and a cracked mask. It only wants the rhythm back.
The Unsung never wanders in on its own. It only rises when someone plays the four-beat on a [Silent Drum](drum_circle), and it returns to that drum in its last phase.
It has **400 health** and **8 armour**, cannot be knocked back and shrugs off potion effects. A boss bar tracks its three phases: Beat, Chorus and Silence.
Bring food, armour, charged Pulse Cells, a Bone Chime and a tested way home. A friend makes it much easier.
pages.title: Before the first beat

text: While it is above two thirds of its health, a shockwave rolls out **every 3 seconds** and hits everyone within **8 blocks** for **6**, with a hard knockback.
Sneak just before it lands to brace: you take **half damage** and no knockback.
Its arm swipe deals **10**, so keep the drum between you when it closes in.
pages.title: Beat

text: Below two thirds it starts calling **two Echo Weavers every 8 seconds**, up to **six** at once, and the shockwaves come every **2.5 seconds**.
Clear the weavers before they slow you. Their bite leaves you sluggish, and you still have shockwaves to brace against.
pages.title: Chorus

text: Below one third it hovers over the drum and cannot be hurt. Every 2 seconds it fires a slow weaving bolt: **5 damage**, Slowness and Weakness. Bolts break on solid blocks, so cover helps.
Walk to the Silent Drum and play the four-beat again. That resyncs it: it is **stunned for 8 seconds** and takes **double damage**.
Silence returns **12 seconds** after each resync, so hit hard, then play again.
pages.title: Silence

text: - An **Unsung Heart**, which crafts the Loom totem ([the sixth voice](sixth_voice)).
- A **Music Disc** of the Drum Circle. - The [Seal-carvers' Rite](tablet_7), the one Lore Tablet no ruin keeps. Hang it on a wall and read it.
If no one stays within **48 blocks** for **30 seconds**, it resets: it vanishes with its weavers and the drum is ready to play again.
pages.title: What it leaves
